$description: ohmtools tokens that do not change with light and dark mode. Generated outputs: npm run build.

sans.$description: Text and headings. Bundled with the app (@fontsource-variable/geist), never loaded from a CDN: apps run offline.

mono.$description: Only for times, rooms, dates, week numbers, group numbers, version numbers and file endings. Bundled (@fontsource-variable/geist-mono).

base.$description: shadcn's --radius, 10px: grid frames, dialogs, drawers. Derived: radius-md 8px for buttons, fields and menus, radius-sm 6px for blocks, badges and tab fields.

divider.$description: The spacing unit around every divider line, on both sides, from the compact step on.

divider-narrow.$description: The same unit on phones (the narrow step).

easing.$description: The one easing: fast out, gentle landing. For every movement.

duration-in.$description: Something coming in: a page, a panel, a week sliding in.

duration-out.$description: Something leaving: shorter than coming in.
